question: A box has dimensions 10 cm × 8 cm × 5 cm. What is its volume?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

⇒ Volume = 10 × 8 × 5

⇒ = 80 × 5 = 400

**∴ Answer = 400 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 10 cm, Breadth = 8 cm, Height = 5 cm

**Formula:**

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

 
• 
• 
• 
• 10 cm 5 cm 8 cm 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume = 10 × 8 × 5

⇒ = 400 cm³

**Final Answer: 400 cm³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**1. Cuboid Volume:** Volume = l × b × h

**2. Units:** Volume is measured in cubic units (cm³)

**3. Surface Area:** TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**4. Cube Case:** If all sides equal → Volume = a³
